description: This file contains the implementation of the ScriptHelper interface, specifically the ScriptHelperImpl class, which provides various utility methods for scripting within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for entity lookup, service invocation, logging, and error handling.

classes.name: ScriptHelperImpl
classes.description: A class implementing the ScriptHelper interface that provides scripting utilities such as entity lookup, service calls, logging, and error handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createServiceMap
methods.description: Creates a validated service parameter map based on the service definition.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles error reporting, setting error messages appropriately based on context (event or service).

methods.name: evalString
methods.description: Expands placeholders in a string based on the script context.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Handles failure situations, setting failure messages based on the context.

methods.name: findList
methods.description: Returns a list of entity records matching specified fields.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity record by primary key, with optional fields and args for cache and select fields.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates a valid entity value object.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Invokes a service synchronously with optional transaction control.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Marks the operation as successful, setting appropriate response code/messages.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Marks the operation as successful with a custom message.
